method: The decision rests on Dunwall safe-room takes under the product controller with Far Reach granted by name (lab-only coop_grant_named) and cast with the native left trigger down the 10 m lane, the partner checked from its own power presentation state on the host observer and the source position polled: coverage-v1350a (candidate 1214cq: a long reach to a floor point about 10 m ahead) and coverage-v1353a (candidate 1214cr: aim, native X cancellation while LT is held, then a second aim and release). Probes power-scenes-probe-v1351a/b found the live aim loop as Scene_2 without a valid target and Scene_1 with one; 1214cr accepts both (before, the aim hold was never presented). The tether and impact are the native network grapple FX. The checkpoint is reloaded after every case.

items.scope: Far Reach in the Emily source role: cast-in and aim loop (variants 4, 5), release (6) and the pull-in (7) are presented; a native X cancellation during the aim presents no release, the source stays put (0.0 m) and the partner returns to locomotion, and a following cast releases and travels 9.2 m to its arrival (1353a); a long reach travels 9.6 m down the lane with the tether at her hand (1350a). Far Reach is Emily-only; the Corvo source role has Blink instead.

visual.verdict: From behind, Emily reaches her left hand down the lane, is pulled off her feet with the tether light at her hand, flies about ten metres and lands at the far end.

Emily reaches out with her left hand and holds it, lowers it again without moving when the aim is cancelled, then reaches once more and is pulled away down the lane; the scene is dim but the poses read.
